title: Cost-effective Extraction of High Molecular Weight DNA from Lichen Material
author: Eva Andrea Strasser

steps.title: Clean lichen material (optional)
steps.instruction: If needed, rinse lichen with nuclease‑free water and dry. Cut into small µm pieces with a sterile razor blade or scalpel, transfer to 2 mL Protein LoBind tubes and store at –80 °C. Add 400 µL cold acetone (–20 °C), shake gently, remove supernatant (store for TLC). Repeat acetone washes until supernatant is clear, then dry samples in a heating block at 30 °C under the fume hood.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer 1
steps.instruction: For each sample (plus overage) mix 1 mL of 100 mM Tris‑HCl; add 10 mM DTT just before use.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer 2
steps.instruction: For each sample (plus overage) under a fume hood combine 500 µL of 1 M sorbitol, 25 mM EDTA, 5.9 mM citric acid, 4.1 mM sodium citrate, and 14 mM β‑mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Prepare 20 % PEG‑0.75 M NaCl buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve NaCl to 0.75 M (58.44 g · mol⁻¹) in a final volume of 200 mL, then add 40 mL PEG to obtain a 20 % (v/v) solution. Vigorously vortex and shake repeatedly.

steps.title: Add Buffer 1 and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Buffer 1 to each tube, flip to mix thoroughly, and incubate 15 min at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g for 2 min (increase speed for crust lichens until a precipitate forms). Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add Buffer 2 and enzyme cocktail
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer 2 to each tube, mix enzymes well before aliquoting, then add 5 µL each of glucuronidase, cellulase, Protoplast F, and lysozyme, plus 90 µL chitinase. Place tubes in a thermomixer at 35 °C, rotate at 750 rpm with a 9‑second pause every 5 min, and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Heat to 56 °C and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Set thermomixer to 56 °C, centrifuge samples at 3000 × g for 2 min, and discard the supernatant in the fume hood.

steps.title: Add ATL and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Buffer ATL, mix slowly and carefully, then add 20 µL Proteinase K and mix gently. Incubate at 56 °C with shaking at 600 rpm for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Add AL buffer, carrier RNA and ethanol
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge to remove lid drops, add 600 µL Buffer AL, close the lid and mix gently on a rocker at 5 rpm (or light shake) until homogeneous. (Optional) dissolve 1 µg carrier RNA in 1 µL Buffer ATL and add 1 µL to each sample. Incubate at 70 °C with shaking at 600 rpm for 10 min. Briefly centrifuge, add 300 µL 96‑100 % ethanol, close the lid and mix by light shaking or rocker at 5 rpm for ≥10 s, ensuring thorough mixing.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to low‑bind tubes
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge to remove lid drops, then transfer 700 µL of the supernatant to a labeled 1.5 mL DNA LowBind tube and the remaining ~800 µL to a second labeled tube (two storage vessels per sample).

steps.title: Resuspend SPRIselect beads
steps.instruction: Thoroughly shake the SPRIselect bottle to fully resuspend the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Bind DNA to SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Add SPRIselect at 1.2 × the sample volume (e.g., 1.2 µL per 1 µL sample). For long‑read sequencing optionally add PEG‑NaCl buffer at 0.65 × the sample volume. Mix gently on a rocker or rock side‑to‑side, incubate at RT for 30 s; repeat the mixing and incubation once.

steps.title: Magnetic bead capture
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic stand, allow beads to settle (time varies), then carefully remove the clear supernatant, avoiding bead loss.

steps.title: Wash beads with 5 M NaCl
steps.instruction: While tubes remain on the magnet, add 700 µL 5 M NaCl, incubate 1 min, discard supernatant. Repeat this wash once.

steps.title: Elute high‑molecular‑weight DNA
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnet, add 20–70 µL nuclease‑free water (or Tris/TE), resuspend beads by slow rocking or pipetting ten times with wide‑pore tips until homogeneous, incubate RT 1 min, then place tubes back on the magnetic stand. If the elution volume is too low for beads to settle, flip the magnetic stand while holding the tubes. Transfer the eluate (HMW DNA) to a labeled 1.5 mL DNA LowBind tube and combine divided samples if applicable.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and fragment size. If fragments are too short, repeat the size‑selection using 0.8 × SPRIselect and 1.0 × PEG‑NaCl buffer.
